<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/i8080.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

78 mnemonics, 244 encoded forms, operands little-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/i8080.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/i8080.rs).

Cycle counts show the base cost; `+p` is an extra cycle when an
indexed access crosses a page boundary, `+t` when a branch is taken.

## Provenance

This specification was authored from the following, in the family's primary reference library:

- *8080/8085 Software Design, Book 2* — Intel (`by-topic/cpu-8080/`)
- *8085AH Data Sheet* — Intel (`by-topic/cpu-8080/`)

Not from any emulator's decode loop: an emulator is a reading of the hardware, and this is meant to be a reading of the documentation.
